source_rights_scope: Research feasibility/evaluation only. No model training or redistribution from KWDLC. Provider's original-author permission and source-URL limitations remain unresolved.
selection_rule: Lowest canonical SHA-256([20261105, 'issue-40-context-contrast-v1', document_id]), then ID, among 3915 pinned public train IDs excluding all 50+250 previously exposed KWDLC documents. No public dev/test membership or body access.

acquisition.rate_limit_policy: Stop scheduling on 429/403, Retry-After, hash mismatch or unexpected failure. Drain at most two in-flight bounded requests; preserve all remaining document slots as not_attempted. No replacement.

eligibility: Original morphemes only, reading 2..32 kana/long-vowel characters, surface 1..32 containing a CJK unified ideograph, preceding source context 8..64 characters within the same annotation unit. Exclude annotated alternatives and named entities. Preserve all exclusion counts and original annotations; no guessed readings or normalization.
lexical_evidence: Original column-3 lemma and coarse POS only. This snapshot has no representative-form metadata. Distinct lemmas may still be spelling variants; semantic intent is unresolved. The zero-eligible representative-field experiment and subsequent 250-document original-lemma feasibility (6 groups/24 rows) remain preserved.
main_slots: One eligible morpheme per reserved document, smallest canonical SHA-256([20261105, 'main', stable_id]). Keep all 1000 reserved slots as acquisition failure/no eligible target/history quarantined/ready; no replacement.
contrast_selection: On source-isolated eligible pool, group by original-lemma basis, reading and coarse POS. At most 32 lemma/surface types per group. Deterministically select two different lemma/surface types, two examples each, with four distinct documents and bounded left contexts, per context_contrasts.py. At most 100 groups/400 rows. No converter/model outcome participates in selection.
source_isolation: Use fixed known source/input history: six source generations, original frozen input hashes without decoding gold/candidates, all three growth source extractions, and all prior 50+250 KWDLC annotation units/inputs. Include every annotation unit of each new document as neutral source-only evidence, even if it yields no eligible target. Exact source/paragraph/sentence and 3-shingle Jaccard>=0.8 transitive closure, plus exact bounded context+reading for actual target inputs. Neutral source-only nodes must never create fictitious input equality edges. Any connected component touching known history is quarantined; keep its record rather than replacing it.
failure_or_insufficiency: Preserve fixed cohort and all exclusions. If readiness is not met, publish the result and do not run #40 fits on an inadequate or silently expanded cohort.
converter_next_stage: Only after committing target and source-isolation identities. Same authenticated reference converter/dictionary as #39/#44, at most Top32, with original labels unchanged. Preserve every missing target, rejection and failure. A later execution plan must bind request identity and runtime before converter use.
model_next_stage: Only after this cohort meets readiness and a six-fit plan is committed: existing C2 versus context-initialized candidate GRU, same training data/loss/features/optimizer/update count/three seeds. No old-dev tuning, vocabulary change or language pretraining in that comparison. All model predictions follow completion of all fits; include intact/empty/shuffled context and paired source-component uncertainty. Candidate absence remains separate from ranking failure.

verify_expect.Verify: Commit source selection/plan before body access and authenticate every selected blob
verify_expect.Expect: 1000 fixed terminal document slots; no prior 300, no dev/test access, no replacement

verify_expect.Verify: Test original-lemma evidence, left-context bounds, source-only isolation nodes, contrast document/context separation and deterministic replay
verify_expect.Expect: No invented semantic/representative labels or fake input hashes

verify_expect.Verify: Recount extraction, closure and selection independently before freezing cohort
verify_expect.Expect: All reported counts match hashes and eligibility; failed readiness stops model training

verify_expect.Verify: Full tests, immutable prior artifacts, raw artifact exclusion and owned process/temp cleanup
verify_expect.Expect: Passing checks; no original-data/model or production change
